lessons.trigger_condition: The V400 portfolio lacked an independent official card/product release surface, while its dashboard integration also attempted a cache-label bump that conflicted with preserved v276 runtime, dock and UI coherence contracts.
lessons.prevention_rule: Score card-release coverage only from local releases.json freshness, official-source, verification, region and game evidence; treat missing evidence as revalidation demand; never invent release facts; and keep the service-worker cache identifier at tcg-v276-network-first-runtime unless the ABI and every preserved compatibility contract are migrated together.
validation_required: V400 exposes five evidence-governed surfaces including card_release
card_release uses KR/JP/US and Pokemon/One Piece/Naruto coverage with official-source and recent-verification evidence
missing card-release evidence is fail-closed and prioritizes bounded revalidation
release facts, prices and grades are never invented
runtime, alignment, exhaustive and integrity guards pass
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V394 binds verified operational release coverage and the cache ABI repair. It does not claim physical-device execution, invent release/price/grade facts, widen trust, bypass CI, execute arbitrary commands, or permit direct Git/main writes.

lessons.trigger_condition: Official product issuance and release data already exists in releases.json, but V400 originally grouped user-facing autonomy into UI/PWA, card measurement/grading, market prices and collaboration/events without independently scoring release freshness, verification recency, release-date precision or KR/JP/US game-region coverage.
lessons.prevention_rule: Treat card issuance/release as a separate evidence-bounded surface. Score only releases.json operational evidence, set missing evidence to low confidence/revalidation priority, steer only canonical V373 declarative capabilities, and keep source-level release feature work as non-executable protected PR/CI candidates with exact canary rollback.
validation_required: V400 SURFACES includes card_release alongside ui, card_measurement, card_market and collab_event
card_release uses releases.json freshness, link health, last_verified_at or link_checked_at, release_date or release_window, official status and KR/JP/US game-region coverage
missing releases.json produces zero release confidence and revalidation priority instead of invented facts
dashboard exposes 카드 발급 · 출시 as an independent read-only surface
release steering uses only canonical V373 freshness, source retry, region priority or observation primitives
material release-surface regression uses the existing exact V400-owned canary rollback path
release facts, dates, prices and market direction are never invented
source code auto-generation, source rewrite and runtime Git/main writes remain forbidden
lessons.safety_boundary: The release surface may prioritize collection and verification work but cannot invent or auto-promote release facts, prices or dates, cannot bypass upstream gates, and cannot generate or execute source-code changes at runtime.
